answer: Sybil floods cheap identities to dilute verifier weight. MoHeng counters with a ferrous stake spiral: each new agent locks 480 POA for 14 days in a cedar-rooted escrow keyed to its first-attest epoch; weight grows 1.7x only after 6 unique peer seals on distinct txids. Cost is ~0.9% cohort float locked. Verification: public escrow height plus seal bitmap. Failure: if seals stay under 4 by day 14, 12% of stake burns and weight resets—no recycled identity reuses the same cedar root.
